DECLARE @hasParentTran BIT
DECLARE @apptId INT

DECLARE CursorAppt CURSOR FOR
SELECT A.apptId
FROM [Case].Appt A
WHERE A.apptStatusConfigId IN (196,197) --196=scheduled, 197=confirmed
	AND A.apptStart < GETDATE()

OPEN CursorAppt
FETCH NEXT FROM CursorAppt INTO @apptId

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN

	BEGIN TRY

		--if no outer tran started, start tran 
		IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0
		BEGIN 
			SET @hasParentTran = 0; 
			BEGIN TRAN; 
		END
		ELSE 
		BEGIN 
			SET @hasParentTran = 1; 
		END
		
		EXEC Custom.prGahpRunOnUnverifyOfAppt 
		@currUserId=1, 
		@currProfileConfigId=16, 
		@apptId=@apptId

		UPDATE A SET
			apptStatusConfigId = 198, --unverified
			apptStatusReasonConfigId = 210, --appt passed unverified 
			updatedBy = 1,
			updatedOn = GETDATE()
		FROM [Case].Appt A
		WHERE A.apptId = @apptId

		--no problem found, if no outer tran, commit
		IF (@@TRANCOUNT > 0 AND @hasParentTran = 0)
		BEGIN 
			COMMIT; 
		END;	
		
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		--problem occurred; if no outer tran, rollback this tran (and its child trans)
		IF (@@TRANCOUNT > 0)
		BEGIN 
		--rollback above transactions then create log
			ROLLBACK; 
			--create an error log
			INSERT App.[Log](logTypeConfigId, logDateTime, userId, logNotes, sqlProcedure, sqlErrorNumber, sqlerrorMessage)
			SELECT 
				434, --sqlexception
				GETDATE(),
				1,
				logNotes = 
				'apptId=' + LTRIM(@apptId),
				'Convert Appt SSIS Script',
				SUBSTRING(LTRIM(ERROR_NUMBER()), 1, 50),
				SUBSTRING(LTRIM(ERROR_MESSAGE()), 1, 8000)
		END; 
		--THROW; --dont bubble up; comment this out because loop should continute even when 1 recordline has error

	END CATCH;

	FETCH NEXT FROM CursorAppt INTO @apptId	
END
CLOSE CursorAppt
DEALLOCATE CursorAppt

UPDATE C SET configValue = 'Appt Conversion completed successfully on ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 20) + '.' FROM App.Config C WHERE C.configKey = 'HomeSummaryAnnouncement.3' AND C.profileConfigId = 16
